versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion, assetRolesVersion and compatibilityGraphVersion are MACHINE-CHECKED: extraction/verify_all.py fails the run if any of them drifts from the version field in the file it names. repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are DOCUMENTATION-ONLY, hand-maintained markers with nothing checking them automatically. The counts block below is also machine-checked -- verify_all.py recomputes every number from the actual files rather than reading it back, and scripts/prove_drift.sh proves that check catches a wrong number.

sourceProject.name: AuthKit pixel-fidelity clone
sourceProject.kind: local clone of a real, live marketing site
sourceProject.stack: React 18 + Vite 5 + Tailwind v3, no component library
sourceProject.pathNote: Deliberately not recorded. This package carries no absolute local machine path; verify_all.py fails if one appears anywhere in the tree.
sourceProject.relationship: This design-repo is a SNAPSHOT, not a living mirror. The clone can be upgraded after this build with nothing re-checking these claims against that drift. Re-diff the stack string, counts and factual claims against the current source before trusting them in a later session.

themeNote: theme.light has no document-level form. It is a `.light` ancestor class cascade applied to the three hero auth-card subtrees and nowhere else, so it is validated per node rather than per document.

licensing.publishingRule: Do not publish this design-repo and do not make any repository containing it public. Treat the source as commercially sensitive.
licensing.designRepoContents: STRUCTURE, TOKENS, GEOMETRY, MOTION and COPY BUDGETS only. No marketing copy, no testimonial quotes, no real people's names, and no brand image files are stored here. Copy constraints are recorded as measured character and word counts instead of the text.
licensing.generationRule: A generated instance must not reproduce or fabricate a real company's logo, a real identifiable person's photograph or likeness, a real person's name attached to a quote, or real proprietary marketing copy. See assets/asset-roles.json.
licensing.exampleNote: schema/example.pagespec.json uses ORIGINAL copy written for a fictional product, respecting every measured budget. This is a deliberate departure from the build guide's 'use real extracted copy' instruction, required by the licensing constraint above.

countsNote: Every number here is recomputed from disk by extraction/verify_all.py on each run.

verification.note: The repo's scripts need `jsonschema` importable by python3. They derive their own root from __file__, so they run correctly from any extraction location.

entryPointsNote: Every path here is INSIDE this package. No '../' path appears, even though the sibling clone source (src/, tailwind.config.js, ia.json, CLONE_SPEC.md, ASSETS.md) is the real evidence behind these contracts. An entry point is a promise about this package's own contents, so a zipped or standalone copy must not reference files it does not contain. The external evidence trail lives in extraction/measured-values.json, which degrades gracefully -- it warns rather than fails -- when no sibling source tree is present.
